source: Issue #206: loaded whole-cell counters cannot describe an unmeasured partial selection.
notes: Amounts use price in cents and quantity in 1e-8 BTC. At base column 1600: 0.01 BTC at 25,000 is 250 USDT buyer-initiated, and 0.02 BTC at 25,125 is 502.5 USDT seller-initiated. Column 1601 adds 0.09 BTC at 25,000, 2,250 USDT seller-initiated. All three are in one overview cell n=12,m=3. Time-only clipping keeps the first two trades; price-only keeps the two at 25,000; clipping both keeps only the 250 USDT trade. The recent trade only makes the initial latest view populated. Expected results do not use the fake's aggregation.
